## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is `Add site: Site Name` and this PR adds one site.
- [ ] The primary link is a direct HTTPS `*.chatgpt.site` URL with no tracking parameters.
- [ ] I opened the site and tested its primary interaction.
- [ ] I linked an identifiable original prompt source, or marked the prompt not publicly available.
- [ ] I recorded creator attribution only when supported by public evidence or direct confirmation.
- [ ] I did not copy a complete prompt without compatible permission or licensing.
- [ ] I did not infer or reconstruct a missing prompt.
- [ ] The description is objective, starts uppercase, and ends with a period.
- [ ] A person independently completed `docs/human-review-checklist.md`.
- [ ] I updated both `README.md` and `data/sites.json`.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and `python3 scripts/check_links.py --changed-only`.
